summary: Hertz Global Holdings filed an 8-K on June 24, 2026, disclosing its intention to offer $100 million of common stock in an SEC-registered offering. The shares will be loaned to J.P. Morgan Securities LLC under a share lending agreement to facilitate hedging by investors in a concurrent note offering. The stock will be sold short by J.P. Morgan or an affiliate. No price per share, premium, or board recommendation is stated. The filing is a capital markets transaction, not a special situation such as a tender offer or going-private, as it involves routine equity issuance for hedging purposes. Watch for pricing and completion of the offering.
